title: Cost-Efficient RAG for Entity Matching with LLMs: A Blocking-based Batch Processing Framework
abstract: arXiv:2602.05708v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) offer a compelling approach to entity matching (EM) in label-scarce settings, yet their matching quality is sensitive to records with ambiguous or sparse attributes due to the absence of external factual grounding. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) directly addresses this grounding gap by retrieving and injecting relevant external knowledge. However, naively applying RAG to large-scale EM is expensive due to per-pair retrieval calls over large knowledge graphs (KGs) and the increase in input tokens caused by enriching prompts with retrieved contextual knowledge. translated_title: 面向基于大语言模型实体匹配的高性价比检索增强生成（RAG）：一种基于分块的批处理框架
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）为标签稀缺场景下的实体匹配（EM）提供了一种极具吸引力的方法，但由于缺乏外部事实依据，其匹配质量对属性模糊或稀疏的记录较为敏感。检索增强生成（RAG）通过检索并注入相关的外部知识，直接弥补了这一依据缺失的问题。然而，由于需要对大型知识图谱（KGs）进行逐对检索调用，以及用检索到的上下文知识丰富提示词所导致的输入token增加，将RAG直接应用于大规模实体匹配的成本十分高昂。为解决上述局限，我们提出了CE-RAG4EM（面向实体匹配的高性价比RAG）框架，通过基于分块（blocking）的批量检索与生成来降低开销。我们通过对面向实体匹配的RAG系统进行系统性分析来研究该框架的优势，重点关注分块感知的批量优化（摘要至此截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出CE-RAG4EM框架，通过基于分块的批量检索与生成策略降低检索调用次数和输入token开销，实现了将RAG高性价比地应用于大规模实体匹配。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes CE-RAG4EM, a cost-efficient framework that reduces the overhead of applying RAG to large-scale entity matching through blocking-based batch retrieval and generation.
